svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 08 · San Diego · 12/12 Sunset, La Jolla (Common)
svg.desc: Everyone stops what they are doing to watch the sun go into the ocean. Some people clap. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
